latest_teacher_action.diagnosis: The previous prompt preserved the turtle count, turtle stripes, croissant count, and the under relation, but it was too weak on two persistent areas. First, 'wooden croissants' was likely interpreted as normal baked croissants rather than croissant-shaped wooden objects, so the material attribute did not bind strongly to the croissants. Second, the trumpets were underspecified spatially and compositionally, so the model likely omitted them or collapsed them into unclear forms despite the white color binding passing for whatever small trumpet-like content appeared.
expected_improvement: Stronger material binding should make the seven croissants read as wooden objects rather than edible pastries.
A dedicated trumpet region with exact count language should increase trumpet presence and make all five trumpets separately countable.
Explicit preservation of the successful upper-croissant and lower-turtle layout should keep the passed spatial relation from regressing.
preserve_constraints: The five turtles are underneath the seven croissants.
Any trumpets shown must be white.

previous_plan_error.details: The plan used generic attribute wording for a hard material transfer case and only said the trumpets were 'placed separately,' which was not concrete enough to force five visible trumpet instances. It also did not use negative constraints against missing or extra trumpets.

latest_teacher_action.regeneration_strategy: Use a simple three-band composition with explicit left-to-right spacing: seven croissant-shaped wooden objects across the top, five striped turtles directly below them, and five white trumpets in a separate bottom row. Strengthen the croissant material with repeated object-level binding to wood, and strengthen trumpet presence with exact count, separate row placement, full visibility, and no extras.
regression_risks: Strengthening the wooden material could make the croissants less recognizable as croissants if phrased too abstractly.
Adding a dedicated trumpet row could crowd the frame and risk overlap unless separability is stated clearly.
Reworking layout could weaken the proven turtle-under-croissant relation if the vertical stacking is not kept explicit.
repair_constraints: The image must show exactly seven croissants, and each croissant must be a wooden croissant-shaped object made of wood.
The image must show exactly five white trumpets.
All five trumpets must be fully visible as separate individual objects, easy to count, with no missing, merged, cropped, or extra trumpets.
Keep exactly five striped turtles directly underneath the seven croissants.

Middle row directly underneath: exactly five striped turtles, fully visible and separated, with the five turtles clearly under the seven wooden croissants. Bottom row: exactly five white trumpets, fully visible, clearly recognizable as trumpets, evenly separated from one another and separated from the turtles and croissants so all five are easy to count. Show no extra croissants, no extra turtles, and no extra trumpets. Keep every object unobstructed, distinct, and entirely inside the frame.
